canada.title: Like sands through the hour glass: Sio Silica soap opera rages on
canada.summary: The Sio Silica melodrama has become Manitoba’s version of the unstoppable force-immovable object paradox.

canada.title: Parents of Regina boy killed in carbon monoxide leak 'speechless' to learn charges laid against building owner
canada.summary: The City of Regina said last week it's proceeding with regulatory charges against the legal corporate owner of the apartments where a boy died from carbon monoxide poisoning. His parents are preparing for the first court appearance in the case.

canada.title: Man dead after home invasion in midtown Toronto, police seeking at least 1 suspect
canada.summary: A man has died after a shooting during a home invasion early Wednesday in Toronto, police say. They said an unknown number of suspects 'forced their way' into a home and shot a resident during a confrontation.

canada.title: Yukon emergency officials deliver smoke and CO detectors to West Dawsonites
canada.summary: Residents of West Dawson in the Yukon recently had some gifts delivered to them by helicopter, courtesy of the territory's fire marshal.

canada.title: Review of changes to Yukon corrections law reveals less solitary confinement, despite more lockdowns
canada.summary: An independent report into the impact of a 2020 law limiting the use of segregation at Whitehorse Correctional Centre found a "substantial reduction" in the practice — even as inmates face lockdowns nearly every other day.

canada.title: Driver in 2025 crash that killed father of 3 sentenced to 6.5 years
canada.summary: A driver in a head-on crash that killed a father of three last year and prompted the Ontario government to introduce tougher dangerous driving penalties has been sentenced to six years and six months behind bars.
canada.outlet: CBC News + Global News + CP24 (CP), CityNews

canada.title: N.S. launches Support Our Troops licence plate
canada.summary: Nova Scotia Premier Tim Houston unveiled the province’s latest specialty licence plate on Wednesday, something he said gives members of the public a way to show their support for people serving in the military.

canada.title: Civic Centre workers, City of Corner Brook reach deal after month-long lockout
canada.summary: The City of Corner Brook says it has reached an agreement with the union representing Civic Centre workers. In a written statement Wednesday, city communications officer Ryan Butt said employees will return to work Thursday, Nov. 26.

canada.title: 'This is a small win,' says vape shop manager after N.L. is pauses plans to ban flavoured vapes
canada.summary: The government of Newfoundland and Labrador says it's postponing plans to amend the Tobacco and Vapour Products Control Act.

canada.title: Sask. budget deficit shrinks to $784M in mid-year update
canada.summary: Finance Minister Jim Reiter says the fiscal update shows Saskatchewan remains resilient in the face of global uncertainty and market volatility.

canada.title: Quebec fugitive on Canada's most wanted list arrested in Ontario
canada.summary: The 19-year-old suspect, who was the subject of a Canada-wide arrest warrant, was arrested by the London Police Service in Ontario on Tuesday.

canada.title: Nova Scotia's new Liberal leader calling on PC government to pause AI data centre
canada.summary: Becky Druhan says the project should be paused until government establishes regulations to protect communities, electricity bills, water supply and the environment.

canada.title: Calgary man accused of possessing thousands of A.I. child pornography images
canada.summary: The use of AI tools to sexualize images or create child sexual abuse materials is a growing problem and has led to several charges laid in Alberta over the past year and a half.

canada.title: N.B.ers hack their way to Canadian win at world timbersports championship
canada.summary: Keswick Ridge brothers Ben and Nathan Cumberland were two of the New Brunswickers representing Team Canada in Germany this fall at the 2026 STIHL Timbersports World Championships, where they won gold.

canada.title: Manitoba Possible opens doors to 'truly transformative' space in Winnipeg
canada.summary: A Manitoba disability services organization has created what it calls a new benchmark for how community spaces, public buildings and workplaces should be built.

canada.title: 3rd former Montreal police officer arrested and charged in connection with racism scandal
canada.summary: A third former Montreal police officer has been charged in connection with the racism scandal at Station 39 in the Montréal-Nord borough. Last Saturday, two other former officers were arrested and charged.

canada.title: King tides coincide with storms across coastal B.C. as evacuation alerts issued
canada.summary: Many coastal communities of B.C. are preparing with sandbags and clearing debris as a king tide coincides with waves of heavy rain and wind on Wednesday.

canada.title: Nanaimo-area teacher banned for life after pleading guilty to possessing child sexual abuse material
canada.summary: Darrell Christopher Gilkes pleaded guilty to one count of possessing child sexual abuse material in April 2025. He was an on-call teacher in School District 68 (Nanaimo-Ladysmith) at the time of the offences.
